PARAMS = {
    "Wb1": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),      # ref-branch nfet mirror width (L=1, MB0 is 2/1) -> I1 ~ 5 uA
    "Wpd": (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),     # pfet diode width [um]
    "kp": (11.5, 6.0, 14.0),     # output pfet / diode pfet width ratio -> load current
    "Lp": (0.15, 0.15, 0.35),    # pfet mirror length [um]
    "Ln": (0.18, 0.15, 0.35),    # gain nfet length [um]
}

VDD = 1.8
VO_T = 0.9   # target output DC level used to centre nfet width


def _bisect(f, lo, hi, n=40):
    for _ in range(n):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if f(mid) > 0:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)


def design(p, lut, spec):
    vg0 = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Wb1, Wpd, kp, Lp, Ln = p["Wb1"], p["Wpd"], p["kp"], p["Lp"], p["Ln"]

    # reference diode MB0 (2/1)
    vgsb = _bisect(lambda v: lut.op('n', 2.0, 1.0, v, v)['Id'] - iref, 0.2, 1.5)
    vsgp = 0.8
    I1 = 0.0
    for _ in range(3):
        I1 = lut.op('n', Wb1, 1.0, vgsb, max(VDD - vsgp, 0.05))['Id']
        vsgp = _bisect(lambda v: lut.op('p', Wpd, Lp, v, v)['Id'] - I1, 0.2, 1.7)

    Wpo = kp * Wpd

    def ip(vo):
        return lut.op('p', Wpo, Lp, vsgp, max(VDD - vo, 1e-3))

    def inn(W, vo):
        return lut.op('n', W, Ln, vg0, max(vo, 1e-3))

    i_t = ip(VO_T)['Id']
    i1um = inn(1.0, VO_T)['Id']
    Wn = min(max(i_t / max(i1um, 1e-12), 0.42), 200.0)
    Wn = round(Wn, 3)

    vo = _bisect(lambda v: inn(Wn, v)['Id'] - ip(v)['Id'], 0.01, VDD - 0.01)
    on = inn(Wn, vo)
    opp = ip(vo)

    gm = on['gm']
    gds = on['gds'] + opp['gds']
    A0 = gm / max(gds, 1e-12)
    ctot = cl + 0.35 * on['cgg'] + 0.35 * opp['cgg']
    f3db = gds / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * ctot)
    power = VDD * (iref + I1 + opp['Id'])
    swing = VDD - on['vdsat'] - opp['vdsat'] - 0.1

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(Wb1, 3), 1.0)
    n.M("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", round(Wpd, 3), Lp)
    n.M("MPL", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", round(Wpo, 3), Lp)
    n.M("MN1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(A0, 1e-9)),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vo,
        "swing": swing,
    }
